propositions: When rebar is installed as a library/CLI/MCP and run against another project, explain guide lookups fail because they read from config.repo_root()/docs/ which resolves to the consuming project's git root, not the rebar package installation.

The two prose guides (writing-a-passing-plan.md and passing-code-review.md) must be accessible via importlib.resources from the packaged rebar._guides module to guarantee installability across any environment.
explain_guide(name) should resolve guides repo-root-independently via resources.files('rebar._guides') mapping, dropping the repo_root_path parameter.
explain_criterion(id) should render criterion sections directly from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body() rather than reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md from repo_root.
Thin pointer files must remain in docs/ to preserve existing document links, while canonical guides live in-package and shipped in the wheel via Hatchling.
